characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When Champion of Gehenna is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, roll a D6 before the fight. A score of 3 or less means that one stat (except W) of the unit can be increased by 1 until the end of the cycle.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6 if the unit with Champion of Hordes attached made a successful charge or has been charged. A score of 3 or less means the unit which has at least 12 bases may re-roll all failed scores in the Weapon Skill Test, and if the unit was not a Horde or it lost the Horde rule, it gains (regains) the Horde rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If Champion of the Dark Gods is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, he always adds +5 attacks instead of +4. In addition, you may roll a D6 before the enemy unit’s attacks. A score of 3 or less means the enemy must, according to your choice, re-roll all successful scores in the Weapon Skill Test or the Wound Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All enemy units within 30 cm of Curser get -2 cm to the charge range.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All friendly units within 20 cm of Warlock may re-roll a failed Prayer Test when praying for Fury.

rules.name: Possession
rules.description: When charged by the Ahsids, the enemy unit (but not single model) must take a Cold Blood Test. If the enemy unit fails the test and has an Action Die, it gets -1 to WS until the end of the cycle. If the enemy unit fails the test and does not have an Action Die, it must take a Panic Test for 3 bases.

rules.name: Human Monsters
rules.description: As long as this unit has at least two full ranks, it has +1 to S.
